FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_edges e2 ON e2.s = n0.node_id AND e2.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND e2.p = ?
JOIN Graph_KG.nodes n1 ON n1.node_id = e2.o_id AND n1.graph_id = e2.graph_id
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p3 ON p3.s = n0.node_id AND p3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p3."key" = ?
